name: poppys-cafe-rush
description: Original cartoon time-management cafe game. Plain ES modules, no build step.

scripts.cap:prepare: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -r index.html src www/
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
